properties.evidence: The same accepted decision that retires every other field report: the repository is public, so a field report is captured into the graph and the file itself is untracked (docs/feedback/ is gitignored). Drawn when the 2026-10-02 fold brought this report to main, because the live store registered it without the retirement and the CI gate then reads missing_artifact on a checkout without the file (fact:defect-registering-an-untracked-field-report-repeated-the-ci-failure-the-decision-already-named). Its absence from a checkout is the design and the build agreeing, not drift.
